tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and Condition As per bid Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder has to submit with the attested copies of registration certificate of firm/company and submit the last 5 years of I.T Filling details. The company have a minimum turnover of Rs. 28.67 lakhs per year.
The agency should be registered with I.T, E.S.I, P.F,MSME Labour Department and other statutory authority of Government of Karnataka.

Bidder should enclose minimum of three years experience certificate of the maintenance of Badminton Court, from the owners/institutions/BNCC concerned officer (not below the rank of Executive Engineer in case of Badminton court belongs to BNCC) State Government / Public Sector under taking / any other reputed private organizations/sports authority organizations, etc.
Should not incurred any loss in more than a year during the last 3 years.
Preference will be given to the agencies thathaveworked in BNCC and other statutory authority of Government of Karnataka with ISO certification.
Tenderer who are in any kind of areas of revenue and contract amount to the BNCC are not eligible to offer their tenders.
Three years of minimum experience is required in this profession, are only eligible to participate in this tender.
